rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose adjective for something distinctive or unlike anything else.

example.english: The cut of this coat is really unique.
example.traditional: 呢件外套個剪裁好獨特。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 go3 zin2 coi4 hou2 duk6 dak6

rows.note: Use this for strong emphasis that there is literally no equal or second one.

example.english: This painting is truly unique; nobody can paint another one like it.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫真係獨一無二，冇人畫到同佢一樣。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa2 zan1 hai6 duk6 jat1 mou4 ji6 mou5 jan4 waa2 dou2 tung4 keoi5 jat1 joeng6

rows.note: Use this when a feature belongs exclusively to one person, product, or group rather than merely being distinctive.

example.english: This feature is unique to our brand.
example.traditional: 呢個功能係我哋品牌獨有嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gung1 nang4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ban2 paai4 duk6 jau5 ge3
